question: Which customer has the highest average monthly change in payment amounts? Provide the customer's full name.
sql:
-- Full query: join customer with avg monthly change, order by highest
WITH monthly_totals AS (
    SELECT customer_id, 
           date_trunc('month', payment_date) as payment_month,
           SUM(amount) as monthly_total
    FROM payment
    GROUP BY customer_id, date_trunc('month', payment_date)
),
monthly_changes AS (
    SELECT customer_id,
           payment_month,
           monthly_total,
           monthly_total - LAG(monthly_total) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY payment_month) as monthly_change
    FROM monthly_totals
),
avg_changes AS (
    SELECT customer_id,
           AVG(monthly_change) as avg_monthly_change
    FROM monthly_changes
    WHERE monthly_change IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, ac.avg_monthly_change
FROM avg_changes ac
JOIN customer c ON ac.customer_id = c.customer_id
ORDER BY ac.avg_monthly_change DESC
LIMIT 5
